searchText: Can someone share app.json configuration for goerli ethstats-client for connection to calaveras? Perhaps a dumb question, but are txns with a 0 priority fee actually possible, or do they need to be > 7 wei (base fee minimum)? no, 0 priority fee is okay - just need fee cap >= 7 Geth won't mine it tho' 😄 Today I merged in a fix that fixes mining those 🙂 Now the miner will enforce a tip of at least `--miner.gasPrice` for all included (non local) txs Aaand, Geth doens't allow you to set it to 0 😄 We might remove that post london though, what we wanted to avoid is mining txs from 0-balance accounts With the base fee minimum being 7 wei, the 0 total price is impossible so we'll probably allow miners setting 0 tip limits [actually, the problem was not mining such txs, rather txpool spam] I might be wrong here, but I believe most 0 tip txns would come from the local txn pool anyways (e.g. sent via Flashbots or something). I think it makes sense to not have 0 tip txns propagate on the network.
